box_invitations_responded_check.name: box_invitations_responded_check
box_invitations_responded_check.value:
case "paldora"."box_invitations"."status"
        when 'pending' then "paldora"."box_invitations"."responded_at" is null
        when 'expired' then true
        else "paldora"."box_invitations"."responded_at" is not null
      end

media_assets_box_scope_check.name: media_assets_box_scope_check
media_assets_box_scope_check.value:
("paldora"."media_assets"."purpose" in ('avatar', 'life_update_image', 'room_banner') and "paldora"."media_assets"."box_id" is null)
        or ("paldora"."media_assets"."purpose" in ('post_image', 'reaction_image') and ("paldora"."media_assets"."box_id" is not null or "paldora"."media_assets"."status" = 'deleted'))

media_assets_ready_check.name: media_assets_ready_check
media_assets_ready_check.value: "paldora"."media_assets"."status" <> 'ready' or ("paldora"."media_assets"."master_object_key" is not null and "paldora"."media_assets"."display_object_key" is not null and "paldora"."media_assets"."thumbnail_object_key" is not null and "paldora"."media_assets"."width" > 0 and "paldora"."media_assets"."height" > 0)

profiles_onboarding_requirements_check.name: profiles_onboarding_requirements_check
profiles_onboarding_requirements_check.value: ("paldora"."profiles"."onboarding_state" = 'username' or "paldora"."profiles"."username" is not null) and ("paldora"."profiles"."onboarding_state" in ('username', 'profile') or "paldora"."profiles"."display_name" is not null)

posts_content_lifecycle_check.name: posts_content_lifecycle_check
posts_content_lifecycle_check.value:
("paldora"."posts"."status" = 'active' and ("paldora"."posts"."content" is null or char_length("paldora"."posts"."content") between 1 and 5000))
        or ("paldora"."posts"."status" = 'deleted' and "paldora"."posts"."content" is null and "paldora"."posts"."deleted_at" is not null)

generated.as: case when parent_comment_id is null then 0 else 1 end
case when parent_comment_id is null then null else 0 end

comments_content_lifecycle_check.name: comments_content_lifecycle_check
comments_content_lifecycle_check.value:
("paldora"."comments"."status" = 'active' and "paldora"."comments"."content" is not null and char_length("paldora"."comments"."content") between 1 and 2000 and "paldora"."comments"."deleted_at" is null)
        or ("paldora"."comments"."status" = 'deleted' and "paldora"."comments"."content" is null and "paldora"."comments"."deleted_at" is not null)

comments_reply_to_check.name: comments_reply_to_check
comments_reply_to_check.value: "paldora"."comments"."parent_comment_id" is not null or "paldora"."comments"."reply_to_user_id" is null

life_update_deliveries_shape_check.name: life_update_deliveries_shape_check
life_update_deliveries_shape_check.value:
("paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."audience" = 'only_me' and "paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."box_id" is null and "paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."post_id" is null and "paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."position" = 0)
        or ("paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."audience" = 'boxes' and "paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."box_id" is not null and "paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."post_id" is not null)

life_updates_lifecycle_check.name: life_updates_lifecycle_check
life_updates_lifecycle_check.value:
("paldora"."life_updates"."status" = 'active' and "paldora"."life_updates"."deleted_at" is null)
        or ("paldora"."life_updates"."status" = 'deleted' and "paldora"."life_updates"."sections" = '{}'::jsonb and "paldora"."life_updates"."deleted_at" is not null)

rooms_location_length_check.name: rooms_location_length_check
rooms_location_length_check.value: "paldora"."rooms"."location" is null or char_length("paldora"."rooms"."location") between 1 and 120

rooms_music_url_check.name: rooms_music_url_check
rooms_music_url_check.value: "paldora"."rooms"."music_url" is null or ("paldora"."rooms"."music_url" like 'https://%' and char_length("paldora"."rooms"."music_url") <= 2048 and "paldora"."rooms"."music_url" !~ '\s' and "paldora"."rooms"."music_url" !~ '^https://[^/?#]*@')

rooms_music_text_requires_url_check.name: rooms_music_text_requires_url_check
rooms_music_text_requires_url_check.value: "paldora"."rooms"."music_url" is not null or ("paldora"."rooms"."music_title" is null and "paldora"."rooms"."music_artist" is null)
